Vacancy for Network Engineer in Hospital Information System (Updated)
Monday, 11 October 2021
4836 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the post of Network Engineer in the Hospital Information System. The applications on plain paper enclosing the complete bio-data, certified photocopies of the academic and experience certificates must reach to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, PO. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha - 442 102 latest by
31/10/2021
.
